responsibilities.quote: Please take the time to complete this module before you start any assessment and remember to check your assessment briefs to identify if you are permitted to use AI or ask a tutor if you are unsure.
it is important you follow our guidelines during your time at the University to uphold good academic conduct and learn to use AI responsibly.
